agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting - audio only - DVD available in the City Clerk's Department
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 22, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Debbie King, President of the Rotary Club of Shadowridge Vista
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of the following Crime and Substance Abuse Prevention Commission’s Law Enforcement Awards:
Sworn Officer of the Year - Sergeant Joseph Mata
Professional Staff Member of the Year - Kristina Nehls
Reserve Officer of the Year - Reserve Lieutenant Ken Pipes
P2.
Presentation regarding the North County Transit District (NCTD) Mobility Plan Update.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ending January 31, 2011 (CC)
C4.
Alta Vista Gardens Special Event Signs (CC)
C5.
Engineer’s Reports for FY 2011/12 Levy of Assessments (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2011- , ordering the City Engineer to prepare a report of the assessments to be levied for the maintenance of improvements of City of Vista Landscaping and Lighting District No. 1;
2.
Resolution No. 2011- , ordering the City Engineer to prepare a report of the assessments to be levied for the maintenance of improvements of City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1;
3.
Resolution No. 2011- , ordering the City Engineer to prepare a report of the assessments to be levied for the maintenance of improvements of the South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District.
C6.
As-Needed Engineering Surveying Services Agreements (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an agreement with Gold Coast Surveying, Inc. for as-needed engineering surveying services;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an agreement with Melchior Land Surveying, Inc. for as-needed engineering surveying services;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an agreement with O'Day Consultants, Inc., for as-needed engineering surveying services; and
4.
Authorize the Mayor to execute the agreements.
C7.
Buena Vista Creek Walk Environmental Services (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Revised 2009-2014 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan and 2011-2012 Annual Action Plan (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing, and
2.
Open the 30-day public review period for the revised 2009-2014 Consolidated Plan and proposed 2011-2012 Annual Action Plan to solicit community input.
PH2.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed levy of assessments on businesses within the CVBID, close the public hearing, and
2.
If insufficient written protests are received, adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , confirming the 2011/12 Annual Report for the CVBID and levying the assessments for the FY 2011/12.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
PH2.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed levy of assessments on businesses within the CVBID, close the public hearing, and
2.
If insufficient written protests are received, adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , confirming the 2011/12 Annual Report for the CVBID and levying the assessments for the FY 2011/12.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
